info.title: Nodera Core API
info.description: Infrastructure, AI, Agent, and Operations control plane. This spec covers exactly the endpoints implemented today — see docs/ROADMAP.md in the repository for what's planned. Hand-maintained (docs/ROADMAP.md tracks generating it from code instead).

tags.name: ai
tags.description: AI Gateway: profiles, provider/model registry, chat

tags.name: secrets
tags.description: Encrypted-at-rest secret storage (metadata only over HTTP)

tags.name: approvals
tags.description: Human approval workflow for privileged/critical tools

tags.name: agents
tags.description: Agent identity, scoped chat, and scoped tool execution (not an autonomous tool-calling loop — a caller directs which tool an agent uses)

post.summary: Create a user (no org membership yet)

password.description: At least 12 characters, mixing letters with a number or symbol

post.summary: Authenticate and receive a session token
Revoke the current session

get.summary: List organizations the caller belongs to

post.summary: Create an organization; creator becomes owner
Register a node (infrastructure.manage)
Register an application (applications.deploy)

get.summary: List the caller's own API tokens

post.summary: Create an API token owned by the caller (organization.manage)

delete.summary: Revoke one of the caller's own tokens

get.summary: List every non-revoked token in the org, any owner (organization.manage)

delete.summary: Revoke any token in the org, regardless of owner (organization.manage)

get.summary: List every role available to the calling organization (system roles + any custom org roles) (organization.manage)

200.description: Roles with their full permission sets

get.summary: List every member of the calling organization with their currently-assigned roles (organization.manage)

post.summary: Add an existing user (by email) to the calling organization as a member (organization.manage) — does not create an account

201.description: Member added, granted the system 'member' role

404.description: No account exists with this email

409.description: User is already a member of this organization

post.summary: Grant a member an additional role within the calling organization (organization.manage)

204.description: Role assigned (idempotent — already holding it is not an error)

404.description: The user isn't a member of this organization, or the role doesn't exist / isn't available to it

delete.summary: Revoke a role from a member within the calling organization (organization.manage)

404.description: The member did not hold this role

post.summary: Create a service account (organization.manage)

delete.summary: Disable a service account and revoke all its outstanding tokens (organization.manage)

post.summary: Mint a token owned by the service account (organization.manage)
Enqueue a job (jobs.manage)
Cancel a queued job
Create an AI profile (ai.manage)
Call the AI gateway with a profile key + messages (ai.use)

503.description: No available, policy-compliant model for this profile

post.summary: Register/update a provider (ai.manage, platform-wide)
Register/update a model under an existing provider (ai.manage)

get.summary: List secret metadata only — never values (secrets.read)

post.summary: Execute a tool — read/safe run immediately, privileged/critical return an approval instead

501.description: Tool has no execution backend yet (NOT_IMPLEMENTED)

get.summary: List the calling organization's per-tool approval TTL overrides (tools.manage)

200.description: Overrides for this organization; a tool with no row here uses the 24h default

put.summary: Set (or update) this organization's approval TTL override for a tool (tools.manage)

400.description: approval_ttl_seconds out of range, or an unknown tool key

delete.summary: Clear this organization's approval TTL override for a tool, reverting to the 24h default (tools.manage)

post.summary: Approve or reject a pending approval (approvals.decide)

409.description: Approval is no longer pending (already decided or expired)

post.summary: Create an agent, starting disabled (agents.manage)
Enable an agent so it can Run or execute tools (agents.manage)
Disable an agent (agents.manage)
Chat with the agent via its configured AI profile and system_instructions (agents.execute)
Execute a tool on the agent's behalf, under its own scoped identity (agents.execute) — the caller chooses the tool, not the agent

403.description: Tool not in the agent's allowed_tool_keys, or outside its permission_scope

bearerAuth.description: A session token (POST /auth/login) or an API token (POST /api-tokens / POST /service-accounts/{id}/api-tokens). See docs/API.md Authenticating.

OrgHeader.name: X-Nodera-Org
OrgHeader.description: Required for a session token (which org to act within). Optional for an API token, which already embeds one — if present it must match.

scopes.description: Must be a subset of the caller's own permissions

token.description: The raw token — shown exactly once, never retrievable again

permission_scope.description: Permission keys this agent acts with — never broader than its creator's own permissions at creation time

allowed_tool_keys.description: Each key must already exist in the tool registry

permission_scope.description: Must be a subset of the caller's own permissions

Page.description: The standard pagination envelope every paginated list endpoint returns (internal/platform/httpserver.Page). Concrete endpoints narrow `items`'s element type via allOf — see NodePage, ApplicationPage, JobPage, AuditRecordPage.
